name: rust-libbin-test-coverage
body:
The two ends of the module-prefix behaviour carry test coverage through e2e tests that write scratch packages under std::env::temp_dir() and drive the staged rust frontend's scanner spool plus the in-process ingestor (the rust_frontend_records pattern, tests/main_e2e.rs:333–357).

The testdata/** directory sits inside apg's own scan scope (testdata/rust/fixture/src/lib.rs, testdata/rust/fixture/src/shapes.rs, and testdata/rust/fixture/tests/it.rs are File nodes in the branch graph). That scan runs under the installed binary, so a committed default lib+bin fixture makes the next repo scan render two crate roots at one FQN and panic — the parent-cannot-depend-on-the-child trap one level down. The fixtures therefore live in scratch directories under std::env::temp_dir(), absent from testdata/. This matches global.constraint.self-contained-tests, which requires every e2e scenario to build its own scratch tree.

Coverage cases:
1. Collision case — a scratch default lib+bin package, [package] name = "foo" with src/lib.rs (lib target foo) and src/main.rs (bin target foo), and the manifest carries zero explicit [lib]/[[bin]] entries. The frontend plus ingestor completes free of a duplicate-FQN panic, and the two crate roots render distinct module FQNs, each crate's units enumerating under its own prefix. This case pins zero suffix literals.
2. Stability case — a scratch multi-target package with distinct target names, [package] name = "foo", [lib] name = "foo", [[bin]] name = "foo-cli". This package scans successfully (distinct display names fall back to distinct prefixes rust.foo and rust.foo_cli). The fix renders exactly rust.foo and rust.foo_cli, with every unit FQN unchanged; the test pins the two FQN literals so any drift fails loudly. This is the requirements.constraint.rust-crate-fqn-stability guarantee.

The stability case pins the rendered bin-crate FQN as rust.foo_cli (underscore), since rust-analyzer normalizes the bin target's display name (hyphen → underscore); the Cargo manifest value stays [[bin]] name = "foo-cli". The collision case pins zero suffix literal — it asserts the absence of a duplicate-FQN panic and two distinct crate-root FQNs.

The change-set commits zero fixtures under testdata/, so the plan declares zero testdata/** planned nodes.
